items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and his brother called him Foster Stan. He's dead too. The tribal place. They both buried.

ctx.x: I knew Dude, man. He used to play with Joe Avery and Wilbur Tillman. That's a guy I knew, Dude. Yeah, he's dead. I have a record in my collection of him.
Yeah, and his brother called him Foster Stan. He's dead too. The tribal place. They both buried.
